title: Chapter 61 Ten Levels Up
content:
Chapter 61 Ten Levels Up

"Damn, brother, are you so awesome?"

Ao Qing was also shocked when he saw this scene.

Use the Heavenly Realm to block their ancestor's powerful attack.

Their ancestors are serious Heavenly King Realm powerhouses!

And I have been in the Heavenly King Realm for countless years, so I definitely have no moisture at all.

At this time, everyone looked at the human man in front of Ao Qing as if he was looking at a monster.

This seems impossible to them.

Also, what is the mark of death?

But at this time, the human man turned his head and looked at Ao Qing and said, "Do you still want to stay in this dragon clan?"

Hearing this, Ao Qing immediately understood.

Although the strong man sent by the master in front of him was very strong, he still couldn't beat his ancestor.

After pondering for a moment, Ao Qing sighed.

"Let's go back."

Now, he is also a little disappointed with the dragon clan.

Maybe, this is really the fate of the dragon clan.

Upon hearing this, the human man did not say much, but turned Ao Qing into a human form, and then grabbed Ao Qing and disappeared directly.

Looking at Ao Qing leaving, Ao Lie's expression was complicated.

Ah Qing, Dad has always believed in you, but it is not as simple as saying that he wants to change the current dragon clan.

Dad is looking forward to your next Hui tribe.

"Old, ancestor, Lord Longzi ran away."

At this time, a Dragon clan member spoke.

In the void, the ancestor of the Dragon Clan stared at the distant sky and said coldly: "From now on, Ao Qing will no longer be a member of my Dragon Clan."

Hearing this, the dragons trembled all over.

.........

In the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng looked up and frowned, but immediately stretched out.

This is also expected.

"system."

【Host, please give me instructions】

After pondering for a moment, Lu Daosheng slowly said, "Get up."

After thinking for a long time, Lu Daosheng decided to mention his cultivation level again.

Because it feels more comfortable to have everything under control.

Now he is in the realm of destiny, and although he is currently in the realm of all spirits, he is still an invincible existence.

But just what he knew was that there was an existence of the same level as him. Who knew if there was still a sixth child in the secret?

Moreover, he has many doubts now, and it is estimated that only when his strength becomes stronger can he solve the doubts.

When he heard Lu Daosheng's order, the system was not vague.

[Please choose the upgrade level. 】

"Emm, get promoted to level 10 first."

[Okay, host, wait for a moment. 】

As soon as he finished speaking, Lu Daosheng's entire body changed tremendously.

A terrifying aura kept ringing inside of the body.

The roar continued.

This huge change did not respond in the deserted city, but it alarmed the entire world of all spirits.

At this time, countless strange phenomena in heaven and earth continued to arise over the deserted city.

No one noticed that the entire world of all spirits was trembling slightly at this moment, as if they were afraid of something.

Buzz —

As the abnormal movement dissipated, an invisible wheel of light spread from the sky above the deserted city and disappeared soon.

In the deserted city.

"The city lord is practicing martial arts again."

"This time, I'm sure I am the lord of the city."

"Oh! Stop looking, the popsicle hasn't been paid for yet."

The people in the deserted city obviously did not react much to this change, and only some creatures in the world of all spirits were shocked by this.

The Lord of the Huangcheng City is so terrifying.

At the same time, strange movements suddenly came from some forbidden areas in the All Spirit Realm.

In an ancient blue hall.

A figure suddenly soared into the sky, looking in the direction of the deserted city with a serious expression.

After a long silence, he seemed to feel something, and then headed towards the direction of the deserted city.

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

Lu Daosheng finally digested the huge amount of knowledge that suddenly appeared in his mind.

Huh ~

As Lu Daosheng took a deep breath.

Suddenly, the entire space collapsed directly.

......

At this moment, Lu Daosheng also noticed that a circle of strange space had appeared around him.

At this time, these spaces are still disappearing.

True Self Realm!

This is his current state.

And now, he looked at everything around him and became different.

"System, have I been upgrading a little too much?"

At this moment, the world of all spirits is almost unable to tolerate him.

But the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm dared not drive him away, because at this moment, he could erase the entire Ten Thousand Spirit Realm with a wave of his hand.

[The host is big, the more the realm goes, the bigger the gap is]

[Warm reminder, please do not have too many emotional changes, otherwise it will cause huge damage to the world of all spirits]

Lu Daosheng:...

Upgrading ten levels in a row, is it so arrogant?

And at this moment, a voice came.

"Dad, what are you, Dad!"

When Lu Xue saw Lu Daosheng's appearance at this moment, she was immediately surprised.

"Don't come over."

At this time, Lu Daosheng hurriedly blocked Lu Xue outside the house.

"Dad, you, you're stronger again."

Lu Xue's voice was trembling as she looked at Lu Daosheng's appearance at this moment.

Can you post to your dad in the future if you look like your dad?

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes, and the terrifying aura began to keep his restrained aura.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng finally barely returned to his previous appearance.

"Xiaoxue, what's wrong?"

Lu Daosheng smiled at Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head.

"No, nothing, just came to see you."

She just felt the huge changes coming from the house, so she was a little worried.

Then, Lu Xue and Lu Daosheng chatted for a while, and Lu Xue left.

Inside the house, after Lu Xue left, Lu Daosheng's expression suddenly became a little solemn.

Because just now, there was a hint of indifference in his look when he looked at his daughter.

That kind of look only appeared when he looked at those irrelevant people.

But now, it appeared in his eyes when he looked at his daughter.

Is this the sequelae of too high a realm?

Shaking his head, Lu Daosheng quickly calmed down and adjusted his state.

The core of the true self realm is to be able to find the true self.

Logically speaking, he shouldn't be like this.

[Host, you haven't adapted to this realm yet, and this situation will not happen in the future]

At this time, the voice of the system sounded.

"In the future?"

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

[Yes, it may take a few years, or even tens of thousands of years]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said: "It takes too long, is there a faster way?"

He can't wait that long.

Although these are just some insignificant minor issues, he is still willing to pursue perfection.

[You can adapt through fighting]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned.

It seems that he hasn't fought much since he got the system.

Usually, he just bullies the weak occasionally.

Wait, bully the weak.

This seems to be possible, but it can't be too weak.

Just as Lu Daosheng was thinking, a powerful aura suddenly descended outside the deserted city.

Instantly, the entire deserted city fell into a state of alert.

Even the desert guards on the walls of the deserted city looked at each other with a serious face.

I saw that in the void outside the deserted city.

A figure was staring at the entire deserted city.

"That, that seems to be a human race!"

At this time, a life spirit in the deserted city exclaimed.

At this time, some old monsters in the Wanling Realm were looking at the Desolate City. When they felt the breath of the figure in the void, a cry of loss of voice sounded.

"Heavenly Fate Realm! How is it possible?!"

That's right, the breath emitted by the figure in the void was exactly the Heavenly Fate Realm.

Moreover, there was no concealment at all.

For a time, the entire Wanling Realm was shaken.

A strong man in the Heavenly Fate Realm was born! !

In the Mansion of the Lord of the Desolate City.

Lu Daosheng looked at the figure in the void outside the Desolate City indifferently.

It was the existence in the green hall.

When Lu Daosheng first came to the Wanling Realm, he greeted the other party.

The other party said that he would come to visit his Desolate City. At that time, he was just being polite, but he didn't expect that the other party would really come.

At this time, in the void, the mysterious man did not feel Lu Daosheng's gaze at all.

Because at this moment, the gap between him and Lu Daosheng was too big.

But he didn't know about this yet.

So when he looked at the deserted city, he was only slightly surprised.

"I didn't expect that there is such a force in this world."
